response.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT orderslink, AVG(rebtotal) AS avg_reb, AVG(feerate - rebrate) AS avg_net FROM fees GROUP BY orderslink), b AS (SELECT AVG(feerate - rebrate) AS bench FROM fees) SELECT AVG(g.avg_reb) AS avg_of_avg_rebtotal, AVG(g.avg_net) AS avg_of_avg_net_rate, AVG(g.avg_net - b.bench) AS avg_excess_over_benchmark FROM g, b WHERE g.avg_net > b.bench
